messages:
aj: Quick sync — weekly GPU forecast posted. Key callouts below, please read and ack.
aj: Summary: APAC/SEA (sea-1) demand jumped ~28% vs last week's forecast after onboarding a streaming partner. Estimated extra GPU-hours needed over next 7 days: ~6.4k. EU-west has a planned maintenance window Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC which reduces effective capacity by ~12% during the window. Our target runway buffer is 15%. Current quick numbers:
```
baseline_weekly_gpu_hours:
  us-west: 12800
  eu-west: 9400
  sea-1: 8700 (now trending to ~11000)
reserved_capacity:
  us-west: 10k
  eu-west: 9k
  sea-1: 7k
buffer_target: 15%
```
aj: Immediate asks: 1) proposals to cover SEA spike for next 72h, 2) cost impact, 3) network constraints to be aware of (cross-region egress), 4) any schedule conflicts with EU maintenance.
maria: Ack. Two quick asks: can we borrow burst from US-W or spin spot instances in SEA? Also need ETA if provider network quota needs bump.
sophia: FYI sea-1 is hitting our cross-region egress cap; ops-bot logged warnings overnight. I just opened a ticket with the cloud provider — ETA 2h for initial response, unclear if quota bump is immediate.
ops-bot: [ALERT] sea-1 network egress usage at 94% — auto-throttle will trigger at 98%.
liam: Options:
- Spin 4 transient T4s (spot/preemptible) in SEA for 24-72h -> recovers ~4.8k GPU-hours; cost ~ $9k/day estimate.
- Throttle low-priority batch workloads by ~40% -> reclaims ~3.2k GPU-hours, minimal infra cost.
- Redistribute some traffic to us-west but increases egress and may hit latency SLOs for APAC users.
maria: +1 to spot spin if network fix will take >6h. Also prefer throttle first if we can avoid extra cost.
sophia: I'll push provider ticket and request emergency egress bump. If they approve, we can avoid spots. If not, I think throttle + 2 spot nodes as hybrid.
aj: Cost tradeoff: spots full option = ~$9k/day. Throttle-only ~ low cost (dev time only) but user impact on noncritical jobs. Hybrid (throttle + 2 spots) ~= $4.5k/day. Need finance signoff if >$5k/day.
liam: I'll prepare spot fleet config, eviction policy set to preserve cache nodes. Snippet I will use:
```
spot_fleet:
  region: sea-1
  instance_type: t4g.xlarge
  count: 4
  max_duration: 72h
  preserve_cache: true
```
maria: For EU maintenance — can we shift a few scheduled rollouts out of the Wed 02:00-06:00 window? We have 3 canaries planned.
aj: Good catch. I'll reschedule the noncritical canaries to Thu morning. That frees ~600 GPU-hours during the maintenance window.
finance-team: @finance-team ping — can you confirm temporary approval for up to $5k/day additional infra spend if needed? We prefer throttle+hybrid. Please advise within 2 hours.
finance-team: (via thread) We can approve up to $3k/day immediately; for $3k-$6k escalate to director. Send a one-line cost justification and liam's runbook.
sophia: Provider replied: provisional egress bump possible but needs org-side form + 2h lead. So short-term we still need spots/throttle.
liam: I'll start the throttle plan now (disable low-priority batch flows) and pre-stage 2 spot nodes; will only spin them if throttle < expected reclaim. ETA to throttle: 15m. ETA to have spot AMIs ready: 45m.
maria: If spots go up, set auto-fallback to drop noncritical A/B tests first — lower user impact.
aj: Agree. Next steps: liam -> implement throttle + stage spots; sophia -> continue provider escalation; maria -> reschedule canaries; finance -> confirm $3k/day approved. I'll follow up with a short runbook in the ops-docs channel.
maria: ack
sophia: ack
liam: ack — starting throttle now
ops-bot: [INFO] throttle_policy applied to batch-job-queue (low-priority) by liam at 2103456901
aj: Thanks team — will post a short update after first 2h check. If anything breaks, ping here and call pager for user-facing regressions. :thumbsup:
